additional_evidence.source: Clement of Alexandria, Stromata II.9; printed Hermas apparatus cites p. 452
additional_evidence.observation: Printed apparatus supplies a bar-delimited Greek clause from Clement where A omits the passage by homoeoteleuton; the inner square-bracket phrase has separate versional evidence. This is not a continuous Hermas manuscript or another A copy.
Unquarried stones provide another internal parallel to the supplied negation at S.9.iii.3; context is not an independent witness vote.
Printed God is conjectural against A nomen-sacrum Christ, L1 Lord, with L2 support reported. God, Christ and Lord must not be harmonized as stylistic alternatives.
